newsitem.title: MOROCCO: PRESS DIGEST - Morocco economic weeklies - June 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Morocco economic weeklies - June 27.

text.p: These are the leading stories in Morocco's economic press. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Cars will be subject to technical checks after five years instead of 10 because of accidents caused by bad maintenance.
- The state plans to replenish finances from new taxation penalties expected to apply from July.

- World Bank report underlines need for a strong state with rules respected by all as conditions to ensure market growth. It says corruption is a serious problem "More than half foreign businessmen spend 15 percent of their time discussing trifles with officials."
- The stock Exchange still gloomy with low volumes traded but analysts say it is healthier after sharp increase during first three months of 1997.
